verdict.rationale: gstack is itself a skill set distributed from a git repo using a git-clone-and-copy install model (gstack-comm-3). Its upgrade skill tells global installs apart from vendored, project-level installs (gstack-docs-7), which implies a team could commit the skills into a project. Dev mode symlinks a checkout into `.claude/skills/` (gstack-docs-16), per-project skills can be promoted to global (gstack-docs-11), and many agent hosts are supported (gstack-docs-13). Missing for 10: explicit docs on team-wide distribution (committing vendored skills to the repo, or a marketplace or plugin listing), guidance on per-repo customization, and hands-on corroboration of team rollout; a community member openly questions how the install model scales to teams with divergent per-repo needs.
